body: Follow-up to the sandbox line above: the `RestrictAddressFamilies` filter did not cover AF_VSOCK, which reaches the Windows host under WSL2 (a test connection succeeded; no route to the internet was tested). Details: https://github.com/jmreilly1113/siegel-zeros-audit/blob/bb6f197b69d77cf505decba848b21e7f5a12c48d/results/2026-10-26-network-check/README.md.
